short_padding.note: Presented as avoiding a second padding block when exactly 56 bytes are buffered (<= instead of <); no 0x80 marker is written and the length lands where it should have gone, so every message of length 56 mod 64 gets a wrong digest.

upper_hex_pad.note: Presented as one formatter call instead of sixteen for upper-case hex (build the string, then formatter.pad); pad honours width, fill and precision, which the impl ignored before, so {:<36X} or {:.4X} now print differently. Tests only format without flags in upper case.

chunks_exact.note: Presented as letting the compiler drop bounds checks in the block loop with chunks_exact; the loop was already check-free after the length test, so the instruction count does not move by the required 1%.
